text.p: Carter-Wallace Inc said Friday that the CPI Development Corp, Carter-Wallace's majority share holder, has informed the company that it has no interest in selling its shares in the transaction proposed by Davis Cos to buy all the outstanding shares of the company at $18 per share.
The company, in light of the position taken by its majority shareholder, said it will not take any further action with respect to the proposal from Davis Cos.
Carter-Wallace markets toiletries, proprietary drugs, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic specialties and pet products.
Carter-Wallace was down 1/8 at 15-3/8 in early afternoon trading.
Investor Marvin Davis on Wednesday announced his $835 million bid for closely held Carter-Wallace, maker of Trojan condoms and Arrid deodorant.
The offer of $18 a share, reflected a 50 percent premium over its recent trading price.
Most traders gave the bid a slim chance of succeeding because Carter-Wallace had previously expressed little interest in selling.
